name: BASS-II

value: Examine burning and extinction characteristics of solid fuels in microgravity to guide materials flammability screening for spacecraft
Identify the worst-case material flammability geometry in spacecraft environments versus terrestrial upward burning tests
Provide data for combustion models used in fire detection and suppression system design

summary.value: BASS-II burned 100 solid-fuel samples (acrylic sheets, rods, spherical section, SIBAL fabric) in a SPICE-derived MSG flow duct on the ISS, varying ambient oxygen via nitrogen vitiation, airflow, and fuel geometry to find minimum burning conditions and extinction limits.
